resume: Medieval groovebox for dance music: thirteen engines on four tracks, each with a 64-step sequencer, an arpeggiator, chord keys, scales and medieval temperaments. It reuses the Felucca controls, and its guide says the panel labels no longer always match.

commandes.role: Octave down. In a question, answers no.
Octave up. In a question, answers yes.
Effects page; held, performance effects on the keys.
Scale page (SCL on screen); held, a key becomes the root.
The engine's eight settings, four per page; held, each white key picks an engine.
SONG page; held, track mutes and solos, tap tempo and MIDI learn on the keys.
Back to the home screen; held, opens the menu.
Save pages; held, undoes the last sound or pattern load.
Track steps; held, step tools on the keys.
Recording; held, erase and click tools.
Changes the track's sound from any page that is not a list.
Picks the track (T1 to T4); everything you do applies to it.

gestes: FX, GLO, SEL, EDIT, SEQ or REC held: a quick layer on the keys. Double-tap: the layer stays open.
SAVE held: undoes the last load.
